adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` when selecting the category from `site_settings` for `embed_category`. If there is no matching row (e.g., the setting was never persisted, so the query returns 0 rows), then `[0]` is `nil` and `nil['id']` will raise `NoMethodError`, preventing the migration from running. The later `if category_id == 0` fallback cannot execute because the exception happens first.
